propositions: E4 assumption verification misses capability-surface mismatches where a plan asserts a named module provides or lacks a capability that is refuted by the code.
Add a new advisory, code-grounded, AGENT-tier plan-review criterion 'asserted-capability' in the G6/E4 rubric family that fires on grounded false capability claims about named modules.
The criterion covers both directions: a plan claiming a module provides a capability it lacks, and a plan claiming a capability is absent when the module already provides it.
The criterion must be registered non-orphan across CANONICAL_LLM, CODEBASE_GROUNDED, AGENT_TIER, routing, rubric, and guide, ships advisory posture and never blocks.
A bounded sanity check over the 3 E1-verified misses (dc58/db7b/5886) plus 3 clean plans must show the probe fires on at least 2 of 3 misses with advisory-only false fires.
The criterion auto-flows into the standing effectiveness recorder with zero per-criterion wiring, feeding the advisory-to-blocking promotion gate.
